<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Opposition challenges ECI:</strong> Led by Rahul Gandhi, 11 INDIA bloc leaders filed a Supreme Court petition challenging the Election Commission’s Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process, alleging voter deletions and demanding the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I28</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I34</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I56</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I58</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Protest and political fallout:</strong> Thousands of opposition supporters marched to the Supreme Court amid heavy security, while BJP leaders dismissed the demonstration as &quot;anarchy&quot; and &quot;anti-constitutional.&quot;<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I31</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I62</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I80</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Allegations of bias:</strong> Opposition leaders, including Akhilesh Yadav, accused the Election Commission and bureaucracy of acting at the behest of the ruling BJP, citing concerns over voter list integrity.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W22</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W23</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Sikkim cabinet resolution:</strong> The Sikkim state cabinet held a special meeting to formally commend Prime Minister Narendra Modi for his 25 years of public service and reaffirmed the state&#x27;s partnership with the Union government.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxOM3hoM0lzQk55ZXkySGtRX1lHdmUwYnlncXpxeFRoUDBiaW5HM1lzNWpLRXlsY3VPZWV6WHdKOWVpcnFMY215RkpoVVRTM1AzSXJFNHN4UFVtZ3kzVS1yVEhiUXJoV0RjNEt1YUltaWloUnpnTGEyMU9Na3hWRmRKN2lEaEtkRGVDekFqR2ZiaXo5akdSRV92U21Md1A1NGx1YXdNb2NSc2hUb2VOQlUybXhGSUNEcjJJeUxv?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W25</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W27</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxNeDl1Y2tLOGRMOUdhNGdaSDNPM1V2ZW5pUXloODlWUlZ2LUxKVVVTczZCQVk3MlhFVEZHaE1ncndPYWQ4dGhXaUc3OUtLQWd2djBydS0xZEVpV2M0d3paNUFTZHhWVGpmbmE5ZmlzLUx2RlBWTG43SjV5N3FTVkxPTHFoc1lFVGtNS21NWHoyX3o1UXJXa2h1bGJ4M053YVBaVWZyQnNUeTBhWl9xMzZjdG5WcTg0YV9MS2hJQQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W29</a></span></li>
